questions.text: The passage tells us about which of the following?
options: The causes of and solution to halitosis.
People who suffer from halitosis
Dr. Katz's problems in carrying out his research
Breath, mouthwashes and popping pills
A research in digestive system.
questions.correctAnswer: The causes of and solution to halitosis.

questions.text: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: People who consume liquor regularly are likely to suffer from halitosis.
People who suffer from halitosis do not go to health club.
People know very well that mouthwashes cure halitosis.
Mouthwashes contain sugar and alcohol.
The easily obtained mouthwash makes 80 million people use it.
questions.correctAnswer: Mouthwashes contain sugar and alcohol.

questions.text: The word "it" in paragraph 3 refers to ...
options: halitosis
sense of smell
proper treatment
problem
method
questions.correctAnswer: halitosis

questions.text: It can be inferred from the passage that ...
options: chronic bad breath can be cured by a dentist
most people are concerned with the treatment of bad breath
protein and bacteria in the mouth are the causes of bad breath
the production of sulfurous gases is carried out in the mouth through two stages
the bitter and sour taste in the mouth are caused by common medicines
questions.correctAnswer: protein and bacteria in the mouth are the causes of bad breath

questions.text: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: Halitosis is caused by bad digestive system.
Some common medicine will create odorless gases.
The bacteria in the mouth are tasteless.
Mouthwashes give effective result in the problem of halitosis.
Halitosis can be detected from the emission of sulfurous gases.
questions.correctAnswer: Halitosis can be detected from the emission of sulfurous gases.

questions.text: The word "nature" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to which of the following?
options: characteristic
existence
quality
state
kind
questions.correctAnswer: characteristic

questions.text: Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage?
options: The primary need of people going to health club is to improve their social life.
The treatment of halitosis with medicine containing oxygen is effective and has no side effects.
The depression caused by halitosis can be lessened by taking medication for high blood pressure.
It is easy to use mouthwashes because the products can be found in any store.
Mouthwashes have a long lasting effect in the treatment of halitosis.
questions.correctAnswer: The treatment of halitosis with medicine containing oxygen is effective and has no side effects.

questions.text: The word "amazing" in paragraph 4 is closest meaning to which of the following?
options: well-known
outstanding
striking
surprising
unusual
questions.correctAnswer: surprising

questions.text: Which of the following foods or beverages are the least to cause halitosis?
options: mint, milk and meat
coffee, candy and cheese
chocolate, ice cream and egg
liquor, cake and syrup
water, carrot and tomato
questions.correctAnswer: water, carrot and tomato

questions.text: The word "exacerbate" in line 21 is closest in meaning to which of the following?
options: exaggerate
evoke
worsen
cause
irritate
questions.correctAnswer: worsen

questions.text: The paragraph that precedes the passage might talk about ...
options: The current research to prevent infections.
The potential causes of HIV in children.
That use of reptile peptides to cure infections
Auto-immune diseases in HIV patients.
The reasons alligators rarely develop fatal infections.
questions.correctAnswer: The reasons alligators rarely develop fatal infections.

questions.text: Which of the following statements is NOT TRUE about peptides within alligators' blood?
options: They are fragments of proteins.
They may stop fatal infections.
They are injected in the human body.
They are within the blood of reptiles.
They have the same function as antibiotics.
questions.correctAnswer: They are injected in the human body.

questions.text: The word 'bruises' in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ...
options: damages.
contusion.
crashes.
swellings.
blows.
questions.correctAnswer: contusion.

questions.text: The followings are what Merchant, the biochemist, experienced EXCEPT that he ...
options: developed two kinds of serum, each can destroy 23 strains of bacteria.
learned why alligators can survive in bacterial environments.
became interested in alligators' resistance to infections.
created a serum which can remove things that cause clotting.
found out that crocodiles can decrease infection caused by HIV.
questions.correctAnswer: developed two kinds of serum, each can destroy 23 strains of bacteria.

questions.text: The writer concludes his essay by saying that ...
options: scientists are now searching for a medicine against HIV.
alligators have contributed a lot to stop human life.
reptiles have peptides which can be used as serum.
peptides in the blood are only found in American alligators.
alligator serum has the possibility to harm human beings.
questions.correctAnswer: alligator serum has the possibility to harm human beings.

questions.text: What is the best title of the passage?
options: The Bumblebees' Life Cycle
The Different Bumblebee Species
A Drop in Bumblebees Population
The Responsibilities of a Bumblebee Queen
The Impacts of the Loss of the UK's Grasslands
questions.correctAnswer: A Drop in Bumblebees Population

questions.text: What can be inferred from the passage about the lifecycle of bumblebees?
options: The new workers are brought up by the male bees.
Bumblebees hibernate throughout winter to survive.
The virgin queens survive the summer and then continue the reproduction.
All the bumblebees in a colony die when summer ends.
The continuation of the lifecycle depends on the skill of the queens in collecting food.
questions.correctAnswer: The continuation of the lifecycle depends on the skill of the queens in collecting food.

questions.text: The word 'undergone' in paragraph 1 can best be replaced by ____.
options: dealt with
confronted
estimated
experienced
coped with
questions.correctAnswer: experienced

questions.text: Which of the following statements about the passage is FALSE?
options: When the colony has been thriving and reached a sufficient size, the queen will lay male eggs.
Some female eggs are laid to produce new queen bees.
The declining population of bumblebees has been attributed to the inadequate food resource.
Nectar and pollen are still widely available even for the choosy species of bumblebees.
A large percentage of the UK area has lost its ability to supply food for bumblebees.
questions.correctAnswer: Nectar and pollen are still widely available even for the choosy species of bumblebees.

questions.text: Why did the writer mention the queens of bilberry bumblebee?
options: To describe how a bumblebee may look like
To give example of bees which can survive the winter
To show one species of bees whose food resource is declining
To give an example of a species of bumblebees which is declining
To give an example of bees which are very selective about source of pollen
questions.correctAnswer: To give an example of bees which are very selective about source of pollen
